vpc_architecture_summary: Penumbra target topology (summary): VPC per-region with private subnets for Redwood inference nodes and customer-managed NAT/egress gateway. Control plane connectivity via outbound-only TLS to Redwood management endpoints over approved egress IPs / PrivateLink option. Optional PrivateLink for model provisioning and metrics ingestion. Inbound: no public inbound to inference nodes; all client traffic terminates in customer-facing API gateway inside VPC (ALB/NLB) and is routed to inference workers via internal LB. Egress: restricted to specific Redwood endpoints and KMS HSM/KeyProxy endpoints; central egress proxy for telemetry and update checks. Regions: primary NA (us-east-1), DR in eu-west-1 per data residency needs. KV caching resides in same VPC subnets; cross-region replication only on approved schedules. KMS: customer-managed keys (BYOK) with Envelope Encryption; Redwood supports KMS API hooks + HSM-backed keys. Audit logging: all request metadata and model selection events forwarded to customer CloudWatch/Stackdriver/S3 bucket with immutable retention policy; control plane emits only telemetry (no PII) and supports signed audit exports. Network considerations: recommend private endpoints (AWS PrivateLink) for control plane, strict SG rules (deny-all then allow list), egress proxy with TLS interception for DLP, and rolling update strategy to avoid long-tail latency.
